aya-de-yopougon-tome-2: A lively Abidjan neighbourhood at night in the late 1970s, young women in bright print dresses seen from behind walking towards a glowing open-air bar under string lights, a baby in a cradle on a doorstep.

aya-de-yopougon-tome-5: A red dirt road leading from Abidjan to a distant village of thatched huts, a small car raising dust, a church with a cross on a hill, seen from far away.
aya-de-yopougon-tome-6: A hospital corridor in Abidjan around 1980 with a window open on palm trees, a vase of flowers on a bench, two young women seen from behind waiting.

aya-de-yopougon-tome-8: A burnt villa at dusk in an Abidjan suburb, smoke rising, and in the distance a remote forest village with a healer's hut, seen from far away.

bienvenue-tome-1: A cluttered Paris art student's room under the roofs, easel and paint pots, a window open on zinc rooftops, a young woman seen from behind painting.
bienvenue-tome-2: A Paris apartment building courtyard with many lit windows, laundry lines and potted plants, a young woman seen from behind climbing the stairs with groceries.
bienvenue-tome-3: A Normandy country house with a garden and apple trees by the sea, a young woman seen from behind walking with two children along a path.

mandrill-les-orchidees-de-volnaiev: A prison van escaping through a Paris street in 1952 and, far away, snowy Caucasus mountains with a secret laboratory, orchids in a glass case.

mandrill-la-nasse: A Leningrad embankment in winter with frozen canals and old palaces, a man seen from behind in a long coat fleeing, a microfilm canister in the snow.

la-chiva-colombiana: A brightly painted Colombian chiva bus on a coastal road near a Pacific port, teenagers seen from behind riding on the roof, palm trees and fishing boats.

colonel-toutou-a-l-ombre-de-paris: A grand African presidential palace with a red carpet and an empty throne-like armchair, and in the distance the silhouette of Parisian rooftops, a man in a military uniform seen from behind.
